note: Literature confirms LRRC7-related disorder presents with hyperphagia-associated obesity in older individuals, while infant presentations report hypotonia and failure to thrive.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 33 individuals with heterozygous variants in LRRC7, hyperphagia-associated obesity was identified as a distinct phenotype, reported specifically in 4 out of 14 cases with truncating variants.

evidence.text: A proband with a de novo missense variant in LRRC7 presented in infancy/early childhood with failure to thrive, hypotonia, global developmental delay, and seizures.

source.title: Further Evidence for LRRC7 Gene Involvement in Neurodevelopmental Disorder: A Novel Variant
source.quote: Here, we investigated a proband presenting global developmental delay (GDD), tonic seizures, failure to thrive, mild microcephaly, intellectual disability (ID), and hypotonia.
